expression: VAR t = FILTER(Sales, Sales[Channel] = "Web") RETURN ADDCOLUMNS(t, "Share", DIVIDE(Sales[Amount], SUMX(t, Sales[Amount])))

ADDCOLUMNS(Customer, "L", LEFT(Customer[Name], 2), "R", RIGHT(Customer[City], 3), "M", MID(Customer[City], 2, 2), "Low", LOWER(Customer[City]), "Sub", SUBSTITUTE(Customer[City], "a", "A"), "Rep", REPLACE(Customer[Name], 1, 1, "Z"), "Rept", REPT("-", Customer[CustKey]), "Cat", CONCATENATE(Customer[Name], Customer[CustKey]), "Ex", EXACT(Customer[City], "paris"), "Fi", FIND("y", Customer[City], 1, 0), "Se", SEARCH("P", Customer[City], 1, -1), "Cs", CONTAINSSTRING(Customer[Name], "O"), "Tr", TRIM("  a   b  "), "Uc", UNICHAR(65 + Customer[CustKey]), "Code", UNICODE(Customer[Name]))
ROW("U", UPPER(BLANK()), "L", LEN(BLANK()), "Left", LEFT(BLANK(), 2), "V", VALUE("1,234.5"), "V2", VALUE("12"))

ADDCOLUMNS(Sales, "F1", FORMAT(Sales[Amount], "0.00"), "F2", FORMAT(Sales[Amount] * 1000, "#,0"), "F3", FORMAT(Sales[Amount] / 1000, "0.0%"), "F4", FORMAT(Sales[Amount], "Currency"), "F5", FORMAT(Sales[Amount], "0;(0);""zero"""), "F6", FORMAT(Sales[Amount] / 7, "General Number"), "F7", FORMAT(Sales[Amount] / 7, "Standard"), "F8", FORMAT(Sales[Qty], "00"))

ADDCOLUMNS(Sales, "D1", FORMAT(Sales[Date], "yyyy-mm-dd"), "D2", FORMAT(Sales[Date], "MMM yyyy"), "D3", FORMAT(Sales[Date], "dddd"), "D4", FORMAT(Sales[Date], "ddd d mmm"), "D5", FORMAT(Sales[Date], """Q""q yy"), "D6", FORMAT(Sales[Date], "Short Date"), "D7", FORMAT(Sales[Date], "Long Date"), "D8", FORMAT(Sales[Date], "Medium Date"), "D9", FORMAT(Sales[Date], ""), "D10", FORMAT(Sales[Date] + 0.75, "hh:nn AM/PM"), "D11", FORMAT(Sales[Date] + 0.75, "General Date"))

ADDCOLUMNS(CALENDAR(DATE(2023, 12, 28), DATE(2024, 1, 8)), "W1", WEEKDAY([Date]), "W2", WEEKDAY([Date], 2), "W3", WEEKDAY([Date], 3), "N1", WEEKNUM([Date]), "N2", WEEKNUM([Date], 2), "N21", WEEKNUM([Date], 21))

ADDCOLUMNS(Sales, "Mod", MOD(Sales[Qty], 3), "ModNeg", MOD(-Sales[Qty], 3), "Tr", TRUNC(Sales[Amount] / 7, 1), "Up", ROUNDUP(Sales[Amount] / 7, 1), "Dn", ROUNDDOWN(Sales[Amount] / 7, 0), "Sq", SQRT(Sales[Qty]), "Pw", POWER(Sales[Qty], 2), "H", HOUR(Sales[Date] + 0.6), "Mi", MINUTE(Sales[Date] + 0.6), "S", SECOND(Sales[Date] + 0.6))

ROW("Sub", SUBSTITUTE(BLANK(), "a", "b"), "Rep", REPLACE(BLANK(), 1, 1, "x"), "Rept", REPT(BLANK(), 2), "Trim", TRIM(BLANK()), "Mid", MID(BLANK(), 1, 2), "Cat", CONCATENATE(BLANK(), BLANK()), "Ex", EXACT(BLANK(), ""), "Fmt", FORMAT(BLANK(), "0"), "Low", LOWER(BLANK()), "Right", RIGHT(BLANK(), 1), "Find", FIND("a", BLANK(), 1, -1), "Amp", BLANK() & BLANK())

ADDCOLUMNS(Product, "DivCur", Product[Price] / Product[Price], "IntDiv", 2 / Product[Price], "MulCur", Product[Price] * Product[Price], "AddReal", Product[Price] + 0.5, "SubInt", Product[Price] - 1, "IntMul", Product[ProductKey] * Product[Price], "Neg", -Product[Price], "Third", Product[Price] / 3, "Round", ROUND(Product[Price] / 3, 2), "Real", Product[Price] * 0.333)
